items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I once asked Joe Venuti what happened, how he felt after Eddie Lang died.

ctx.x: I once asked Joe Venuti what happened, how he felt after Eddie Lang died. And he said it was like half of me died. Well when Wellstood died I felt that way.
That’s something to sustain a band like that too without a bass player I think.
